materials.finish: Smooth light warm putty/pearl greige, with enough tonal depth to distinguish the white upholstery. No cloudy cream-beige plaster effect.
materials.description: Apply the common pearl/putty paint only to actual dry wall surfaces.
materials.substratePreparation: Inspect and repair existing drywall/plaster, resolve moisture causes, fill and sand defects, use substrate-compatible primer and follow the current paint data sheet for preparation, coats and curing. Skim only the affected visible areas where raking light reveals defects. A smooth finish does not require a decorative mineral-plaster coating.
materials.installation: Premium washable matte acrylic paint. Benjamin Moore Aura Matte is the sample system; Pale Oak OC-20 and Balboa Mist OC-27 are competing large-board color candidates, not final selected colors. Choose one connected-floor neutral after looking beside the actual Brown Oak, polished stainless, white fabric and daylight.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve large movable boards in morning, afternoon and artificial light. Record exact product, color code, sheen and batch before ordering.
materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.surface: Trim, light interior doors and ceilings
materials.finish: Soft warm white; ceilings flat, doors and trim a clean low satin. Clear gallery door glass stays clear.
materials.description: Retain light trim/doors and actual ceiling profiles.
materials.substratePreparation: Degloss and clean old coatings as required; inspect adhesion, fill joints correctly and prime repaired or bare substrate. Do not paint door glass, hinges, smoke devices or vents shut.
materials.installation: Manufacturer-compatible trim enamel on prepared existing wood/MDF and flat ceiling paint. White Dove OC-17 is a sample candidate only. Preserve existing crown and ceiling profiles.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve the actual material and room samples in daylight and specified artificial light before full ordering or fabrication.
materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.surface: Dry interior floors and stair treads
materials.finish: Light-to-medium neutral natural white-oak appearance, matte and visibly lighter than the smoky furniture; restrained grain and knots. Neither gray vinyl nor orange/honey oak.
materials.description: Use continuous neutral natural-oak appearance floor/treads in this dry room. No stair runners, stair rods or adhesive tread carpets. Preserve the actual quarter-turn/half-landing/straight-flight shape and compliant handrail/guard. Installer to address any required traction detail without inventing a runner.
materials.substratePreparation: Flooring contractor checks flatness, moisture, acclimation and manufacturer installation instructions. Complete dirty rough work before finish flooring. Protect finished floors without trapping moisture. Match stair stain by a full tread sample.
materials.installation: Assess the existing floor construction, wear layer, moisture and condition before deciding to refinish or replace. For replacement use a sample-approved engineered oak system appropriate to the subfloor; dimensions, grade, wear layer and installation method remain to be selected. Coordinate a consistent finished-floor height and actual transitions.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve the actual material and room samples in daylight and specified artificial light before full ordering or fabrication.
materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.finish: Smoky BROWN OAK with gray/charcoal undertones and recognizable open oak grain. Satin-matte protective finish. New floor-standing storage has a continuous recessed/flush plinth; no spindly feet or floating storage.
materials.description: Apply the smoky brown-oak and selective silver details only to the specified new/refaced joinery. Owned furniture remains authentic. The actual owned Bezier and Machinto pieces keep their authentic fronts, supports, metal bands and bases. Maslow’s Espresso Walnut/Polished Aluminum and Cabrera’s Charcoal Waxed Concrete are actual owned exceptions. Never remodel owned furniture to look like the new joinery rule.
materials.substratePreparation: Cabinetmaker to specify stable carcasses, veneer lay-up, concealed attachment, service access, ventilation, edge sealing and finished plinths. Keep doors/drawers serviceable after flooring. Provide shop drawings before fabrication.
materials.installation: Use sound existing or standard cabinet boxes where practical, with sample-approved brown-oak veneer/solid edging and varied fronts: calm slab doors, limited thin frames, a few reeded-glass uppers or display doors. Polished stainless pulls, edge grips or fine reveals are selective accents. Do not repeat full-width metal drawer bands throughout the house.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve the actual material and room samples in daylight and specified artificial light before full ordering or fabrication.
materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

Separate each quote into measured materials, installation labor, electrical/AV/shade work and exclusions. No costs or available inventory are invented in this specification. Product prices and delivery are dated retailer quotes only; pending configurations are not purchase-ready.

Sequence vacant-house dirty work, rough-ins and inspections before permanent flooring, cabinet fronts, final wall coatings and drapes. Provide trade protection and final commissioning before placing owned pieces. Bedroom 5 new-room construction remains a separately drawn and permitted future scope.

materials.finish: Smooth light warm putty/pearl greige, with enough tonal depth to distinguish the white upholstery. No cloudy cream-beige plaster effect.

Skim only the affected visible areas where raking light reveals defects. A smooth finish does not require a decorative mineral-plaster coating.
materials.installation: Premium washable matte acrylic paint. Benjamin Moore Aura Matte is the sample system; Pale Oak OC-20 and Balboa Mist OC-27 are competing large-board color candidates, not final selected colors. Choose one connected-floor neutral after looking beside the actual Brown Oak, polished stainless, white fabric and daylight.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve large movable boards in morning, afternoon and artificial light. Record exact product, color code, sheen and batch before ordering.
materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.description: Retain light trim/doors and actual ceiling profiles.
materials.substratePreparation: Degloss and clean old coatings as required; inspect adhesion, fill joints correctly and prime repaired or bare substrate. Do not paint door glass, hinges, smoke devices or vents shut.
materials.installation: Manufacturer-compatible trim enamel on prepared existing wood/MDF and flat ceiling paint. White Dove OC-17 is a sample candidate only. Preserve existing crown and ceiling profiles.

materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.surface: Dry interior floors and stair treads
materials.finish: Light-to-medium neutral natural white-oak appearance, matte and visibly lighter than the smoky furniture; restrained grain and knots. Neither gray vinyl nor orange/honey oak.
materials.description: Use continuous neutral natural-oak appearance floor/treads in this dry room. No stair runners, stair rods or adhesive tread carpets. Preserve the actual quarter-turn/half-landing/straight-flight shape and compliant handrail/guard. Installer to address any required traction detail without inventing a runner.
materials.substratePreparation: Flooring contractor checks flatness, moisture, acclimation and manufacturer installation instructions. Complete dirty rough work before finish flooring. Protect finished floors without trapping moisture. Match stair stain by a full tread sample.
materials.installation: Assess the existing floor construction, wear layer, moisture and condition before deciding to refinish or replace. For replacement use a sample-approved engineered oak system appropriate to the subfloor; dimensions, grade, wear layer and installation method remain to be selected. Coordinate a consistent finished-floor height and actual transitions.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve the actual material and room samples in daylight and specified artificial light before full ordering or fabrication.
materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.finish: Smoky BROWN OAK with gray/charcoal undertones and recognizable open oak grain. Satin-matte protective finish. New floor-standing storage has a continuous recessed/flush plinth; no spindly feet or floating storage.
materials.description: Apply the smoky brown-oak and selective silver details only to the specified new/refaced joinery. Owned furniture remains authentic. The actual owned Bezier and Machinto pieces keep their authentic fronts, supports, metal bands and bases. Maslow’s Espresso Walnut/Polished Aluminum and Cabrera’s Charcoal Waxed Concrete are actual owned exceptions. Never remodel owned furniture to look like the new joinery rule.
materials.substratePreparation: Cabinetmaker to specify stable carcasses, veneer lay-up, concealed attachment, service access, ventilation, edge sealing and finished plinths. Keep doors/drawers serviceable after flooring. Provide shop drawings before fabrication.
materials.installation: Use sound existing or standard cabinet boxes where practical, with sample-approved brown-oak veneer/solid edging and varied fronts: calm slab doors, limited thin frames, a few reeded-glass uppers or display doors. Polished stainless pulls, edge grips or fine reveals are selective accents. Do not repeat full-width metal drawer bands throughout the house.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve the actual material and room samples in daylight and specified artificial light before full ordering or fabrication.
materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.surface: Kitchen and wet-room counters; selected focal porcelain
materials.finish: Quiet pearl-white to light warm gray Carrara-like porcelain or a low-contrast white/gray engineered counter surface. Fine gray veining, low contrast, no gold/rust veining, heavy onyx clouding or tan limestone scheme.
materials.description: Use this room’s stated quiet pearl-gray material hierarchy; actual product, surface finish and tile layout require approval. Kitchen uses the quietest fine gray vein. Owners bath may have slightly broader pearl-gray movement. Shared and smaller baths use calmer economical field tiles. Fireplace remains a restrained pearl-gray surround, not an extravagant bookmatched statement. No automatic transfer of Option 1 studies A, C 1 or E.
materials.substratePreparation: Tile/slab installer and fabricator coordinate approved backer, waterproofing where wet, substrate flatness, joint layout, reinforcement, edge details, cutouts and movement joints under the chosen system instructions. Approve a full actual tile/slab and seam drawing.
materials.installation: Kitchen counter finish is a practical sample-approved quartz or porcelain surface after comparing fabrication cost and existing-box condition. Wet walls use an actual rated porcelain tile/slab product; Daltile’s marble-look collections are sourcing leads rather than a final named SKU. Consider satin/honed-looking wall surfaces and a suitable matte wet-floor version; never assume a polished wall slab is an appropriate slip-resistant floor.

materials.sampleApproval: Approve the actual material and room samples in daylight and specified artificial light before full ordering or fabrication.

materials.finish: Smooth light warm putty/pearl greige, with enough tonal depth to distinguish the white upholstery. No cloudy cream-beige plaster effect.
materials.description: Apply the common pearl/putty paint only to actual dry wall surfaces.
materials.substratePreparation: Inspect and repair existing drywall/plaster, resolve moisture causes, fill and sand defects, use substrate-compatible primer and follow the current paint data sheet for preparation, coats and curing. Skim only the affected visible areas where raking light reveals defects. A smooth finish does not require a decorative mineral-plaster coating.
materials.installation: Premium washable matte acrylic paint. Benjamin Moore Aura Matte is the sample system; Pale Oak OC-20 and Balboa Mist OC-27 are competing large-board color candidates, not final selected colors. materials.care: Follow the selected manufacturer cleaning, maintenance and repair directions; retain product data and matching repair material.

materials.finish: Soft warm white; ceilings flat, doors and trim a clean low satin. Clear gallery door glass stays clear.
materials.description: Retain light trim/doors and actual ceiling profiles.
materials.substratePreparation: Degloss and clean old coatings as required; inspect adhesion, fill joints correctly and prime repaired or bare substrate. Do not paint door glass, hinges, smoke devices or vents shut.
materials.installation: Manufacturer-compatible trim enamel on prepared existing wood/MDF and flat ceiling paint. White Dove OC-17 is a sample candidate only. Preserve existing crown and ceiling profiles.

materials.finish: Smoky BROWN OAK with gray/charcoal undertones and recognizable open oak grain. Satin-matte protective finish. New floor-standing storage has a continuous recessed/flush plinth; no spindly feet or floating storage.
materials.description: Apply the smoky brown-oak and selective silver details only to the specified new/refaced joinery. Owned furniture remains authentic. The actual owned Bezier and Machinto pieces keep their authentic fronts, supports, metal bands and bases. Maslow’s Espresso Walnut/Polished Aluminum and Cabrera’s Charcoal Waxed Concrete are actual owned exceptions. Never remodel owned furniture to look like the new joinery rule.
materials.substratePreparation: Cabinetmaker to specify stable carcasses, veneer lay-up, concealed attachment, service access, ventilation, edge sealing and finished plinths. Keep doors/drawers serviceable after flooring. Provide shop drawings before fabrication.
materials.installation: Use sound existing or standard cabinet boxes where practical, with sample-approved brown-oak veneer/solid edging and varied fronts: calm slab doors, limited thin frames, a few reeded-glass uppers or display doors. Polished stainless pulls, edge grips or fine reveals are selective accents. Do not repeat full-width metal drawer bands throughout the house.
materials.sampleApproval: Approve the actual material and room samples in daylight and specified artificial light before full ordering or fabrication.

materials.surface: Kitchen and wet-room counters; selected focal porcelain
materials.finish: Quiet pearl-white to light warm gray Carrara-like porcelain or a low-contrast white/gray engineered counter surface. Fine gray veining, low contrast, no gold/rust veining, heavy onyx clouding or tan limestone scheme.
materials.description: Use quiet pearl-gray porcelain on the specified wet walls and a suitable matte wet-floor porcelain on the entire bathroom floor. Wall tile sheen and format do not automatically transfer to the floor. Coordinate shower floor slope, drain, waterproofing, movement joints and tile cuts under the selected tested system. Counters are coordinated quiet pearl/white-gray surfaces. Actual products, sizes, slip suitability, seam layout and installation details require approval; no wood-look interior oak floor is specified here. Kitchen uses the quietest fine gray vein. Owners bath may have slightly broader pearl-gray movement. Shared and smaller baths use calmer economical field tiles. Fireplace remains a restrained pearl-gray surround, not an extravagant bookmatched statement. No automatic transfer of Option 1 studies A, C 1 or E.
materials.substratePreparation: Tile/slab installer and fabricator coordinate approved backer, waterproofing where wet, substrate flatness, joint layout, reinforcement, edge details, cutouts and movement joints under the chosen system instructions. Approve a full actual tile/slab and seam drawing.
materials.installation: Kitchen counter finish is a practical sample-approved quartz or porcelain surface after comparing fabrication cost and existing-box condition. Wet walls use an actual rated porcelain tile/slab product; Daltile’s marble-look collections are sourcing leads rather than a final named SKU. Consider satin/honed-looking wall surfaces and a suitable matte wet-floor version; never assume a polished wall slab is an appropriate slip-resistant floor.

globalStandards.designIntent: Cocoa & Chrome is a polished modern house built around smoky gray-brown oak, reflective silver metals, white upholstery and light warm putty/pearl walls. Blue belongs in artwork and removable textiles; butter-yellow is a smaller removable accent. Plants supply green. Do not introduce Mineral & Walnut’s walnut furniture, golden metal, brown plaster recipe or its approved A/C1/E stone selections.

CC-W1.appearance: Smooth light warm putty/pearl greige, with enough tonal depth to distinguish the white upholstery. No cloudy cream-beige plaster effect.
CC-W1.approach: Premium washable matte acrylic paint. Benjamin Moore Aura Matte is the sample system; Pale Oak OC-20 and Balboa Mist OC-27 are competing large-board color candidates, not final selected colors. Choose one connected-floor neutral after looking beside the actual Brown Oak, polished stainless, white fabric and daylight.
CC-W1.substrate: Inspect and repair existing drywall/plaster, resolve moisture causes, fill and sand defects, use substrate-compatible primer and follow the current paint data sheet for preparation, coats and curing. Skim only the affected visible areas where raking light reveals defects. A smooth finish does not require a decorative mineral-plaster coating.
CC-W1.sampleApproval: Approve large movable boards in morning, afternoon and artificial light. Record exact product, color code, sheen and batch before ordering.

CC-W2.surface: Trim, light interior doors and ceilings
CC-W2.appearance: Soft warm white; ceilings flat, doors and trim a clean low satin. Clear gallery door glass stays clear.
CC-W2.approach: Manufacturer-compatible trim enamel on prepared existing wood/MDF and flat ceiling paint. White Dove OC-17 is a sample candidate only. Preserve existing crown and ceiling profiles.
CC-W2.substrate: Degloss and clean old coatings as required; inspect adhesion, fill joints correctly and prime repaired or bare substrate. Do not paint door glass, hinges, smoke devices or vents shut.

CC-O1.surface: Dry interior floors and stair treads
CC-O1.appearance: Light-to-medium neutral natural white-oak appearance, matte and visibly lighter than the smoky furniture; restrained grain and knots. Neither gray vinyl nor orange/honey oak.
CC-O1.approach: Assess the existing floor construction, wear layer, moisture and condition before deciding to refinish or replace. For replacement use a sample-approved engineered oak system appropriate to the subfloor; dimensions, grade, wear layer and installation method remain to be selected. Coordinate a consistent finished-floor height and actual transitions.
CC-O1.substrate: Flooring contractor checks flatness, moisture, acclimation and manufacturer installation instructions. Complete dirty rough work before finish flooring. Protect finished floors without trapping moisture. Match stair stain by a full tread sample.
CC-O1.stairRule: No stair runners, stair rods or adhesive tread carpets. Preserve the actual quarter-turn/half-landing/straight-flight shape and compliant handrail/guard. Installer to address any required traction detail without inventing a runner.

CC-J1.appearance: Smoky BROWN OAK with gray/charcoal undertones and recognizable open oak grain. Satin-matte protective finish. New floor-standing storage has a continuous recessed/flush plinth; no spindly feet or floating storage.
CC-J1.approach: Use sound existing or standard cabinet boxes where practical, with sample-approved brown-oak veneer/solid edging and varied fronts: calm slab doors, limited thin frames, a few reeded-glass uppers or display doors. Polished stainless pulls, edge grips or fine reveals are selective accents. Do not repeat full-width metal drawer bands throughout the house.
CC-J1.substrate: Cabinetmaker to specify stable carcasses, veneer lay-up, concealed attachment, service access, ventilation, edge sealing and finished plinths. Keep doors/drawers serviceable after flooring. Provide shop drawings before fabrication.
CC-J1.ownedException: The actual owned Bezier and Machinto pieces keep their authentic fronts, supports, metal bands and bases. Maslow’s Espresso Walnut/Polished Aluminum and Cabrera’s Charcoal Waxed Concrete are actual owned exceptions. Never remodel owned furniture to look like the new joinery rule.

CC-S1.surface: Kitchen and wet-room counters; selected focal porcelain
CC-S1.appearance: Quiet pearl-white to light warm gray Carrara-like porcelain or a low-contrast white/gray engineered counter surface. Fine gray veining, low contrast, no gold/rust veining, heavy onyx clouding or tan limestone scheme.
CC-S1.approach: Kitchen counter finish is a practical sample-approved quartz or porcelain surface after comparing fabrication cost and existing-box condition. Wet walls use an actual rated porcelain tile/slab product; Daltile’s marble-look collections are sourcing leads rather than a final named SKU. Consider satin/honed-looking wall surfaces and a suitable matte wet-floor version; never assume a polished wall slab is an appropriate slip-resistant floor.
CC-S1.substrate: Tile/slab installer and fabricator coordinate approved backer, waterproofing where wet, substrate flatness, joint layout, reinforcement, edge details, cutouts and movement joints under the chosen system instructions. Approve a full actual tile/slab and seam drawing.
CC-S1.hierarchy: Kitchen uses the quietest fine gray vein. Owners bath may have slightly broader pearl-gray movement. Shared and smaller baths use calmer economical field tiles. Fireplace remains a restrained pearl-gray surround, not an extravagant bookmatched statement. No automatic transfer of Option 1 studies A, C 1 or E.

CC-M1.appearance: Actual owned polished stainless and polished nickel govern the nearby finish samples. New fittings may use polished stainless, polished nickel or chrome when sample coordinated.
CC-M1.approach: Choose one compatible polished-silver finish family per room. Match appearance by real samples; stainless, nickel and chrome are not chemically identical finishes. Keep black limited to AV, piano, selected chair supports and thin art frames. No new brass/gold fixtures.
CC-M1.care: Use each manufacturer’s cleaning directions. Do not spray abrasive or acidic cleaners across polished metal or stone.

CC-T1.appearance: Warm-white/ecru linen-look ripple-fold sheers; hidden off-white opaque/privacy layers and true blackout where required. Ivory/stone rugs with subtle taupe/gray texture. White upholstery, a few ink/slate/soft-blue textiles and a smaller butter-yellow highlight.
CC-T1.approach: Curtain workroom measures actual glazing, curve/arch heads, side returns, stackback, track support and finished floor. Sheers are not a night-privacy specification. Keep a wood border around each bedroom rug; exact rug sizes and actual owned fabrics govern.
CC-T1.sampleApproval: Approve curtain fabric against the owned White Italian Textured Weave and White Perennials. Check opacity with a lamp at night; view full panel and blackout side-gap sample.

CC-G1.appearance: Quiet charcoal/black rubber, with clean perimeter and no area rug.
CC-G1.approach: Select an indoor rubber product suitable for the existing subfloor, expected use and odor requirements. Confirm adhesive, expansion and moisture preparation with its manufacturer. No equipment is included in this design.

CC-X1.appearance: Preserve the actual white-brick house, roof forms, deck, railings and established pergola/shade sails. The selected new Malibu furnishings use Black powder-coated outdoor aluminum and separately purchased White outdoor cushions, with restrained removable blue/butter-yellow accents and green planters. Do not substitute the prior teak scheme or indoor stainless furniture.
CC-X1.approach: No indoor oak veneer, normal interior paint, indoor curtains or indoor furniture outdoors. Confirm wind, drainage, loads, fastening, corrosion and maintenance with the appropriate trades. Existing deck/roof repairs are surveyed separately; no new roof geometry is proposed.
